mapper.sql: d.organization_id = #{org} AND d.status <> 'DELETED' AND (d.visibility = 'TEAM' OR d.uploaded_by_member_id = #{member})

SELECT d.id, d.uploaded_by_member_id, d.file_id, d.title, d.category, d.visibility, d.status, d.enabled, d.chunk_count, d.character_count, d.error_message, d.revision, d.version, f.original_filename AS filename, f.size_bytes, u.display_name AS uploaded_by_name, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM knowledge_document d JOIN uploaded_file f ON f.organization_id = d.organization_id AND f.id = d.file_id JOIN organization_member m ON m.organization_id = d.organization_id AND m.id = d.uploaded_by_member_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE
mapper.select: AND d.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF d
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document(id, organization_id, uploaded_by_member_id, file_id, title, category, visibility, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{org}, #{member}, #{file}, #{input.title}, #{input.category}, #{input.visibility}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET enabled = #{enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status <> 'DELETED'

UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = CASE WHEN CAST(#{error} AS text) IS NULL THEN 'READY' ELSE 'FAILED' END, chunk_count = #{count}, character_count = #{characters}, error_message = #{error}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 'DELETED', enabled = false, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status <> 'DELETED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND document_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (id, organization_id, document_id, revision, chunk_index, page_number, content, search_terms) VALUES (#{id}, #{org}, #{document}, #{revision}, #{index}, #{pageNumber}, #{content}, #{terms})
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.page_number, d.title, c.content, c.revision FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.organization_id = c.organization_id AND d.id = c.document_id WHERE AND c.revision = d.revision
mapper.select: AND d.enabled = true AND d.status = 'READY' AND d.id = #{document} AND c.search_vector @@ to_tsquery('simple', #{searchQuery}) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(c.search_vector, to_tsquery('simple', #{searchQuery})) DESC, c.id LIMIT 60

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.organization_id = c.organization_id AND d.id = c.document_id WHERE AND d.status = 'READY' AND d.enabled = true AND c.id = #{id} AND c.revision = #{revision} AND c.revision = d.revision
